Sunders the target's soul, dealing 65% Shadowstrike weapon damage (52% if a two-handed weapon is equipped) plus 3 and increases your spell critical strike chance against the target by 3%. Stacks 5 times and lasts for 15 sec.

This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Become an embodiment of the sun for 30 sec, periodically dispelling fear, sleep, and charm effects every 3 sec from allies within 40 yds.

This spell belongs to Witch Hunter

Drink a bitter tonic, increasing your haste by 15% and reducing the cost of all abilities by 20% for 15 sec.
records.name: Surging Tonic

records.description:
This spell belongs to Templar

Meditate for 15 sec, restoring 5% of your base health every 1 sec and reducing damage taken by 20%.

Each second you will also remove 1 disease effect from yourself.
records.name: Testament of Fortitude

records.description:
Teaches you the necessary abilities to tether an Elemental companion.

Teaches you Tether Elemental, Raise Elemental, Dismiss Elemental, Revive Elemental and Elemental Lore.
records.name: Tether Elemental

records.description:
This spell belongs to Stormbringer

Mark an enemy for 4 sec. Every 1 sec, enemies near them take 23 Nature damage.

At the end of the duration, enemies near them also take 71 Nature damage and are rooted for 4 sec.

Steals a beneficial magic effect from the target. Stolen effects last a maximum of 2 min.

Does not break stealth.

Usable while stunned.

Healing Wave: Heals the target again for 30% of the original amount healed after 1 second.

Chain Heal: No longer diminishes in healing with each jump.

Healing Rain: Duration is increased by 50%.

This spell belongs to Chronomancer

Enter a stasis for 6 sec, instantly restoring 15% of your maximum mana and regenerating 5% of your maximum mana every 0.50 sec.

While active, your damage taken is reduced by 50% but any direct damage taken may end the effect.

Returns you to your active Temporal Anomaly.

While you know this spell casting Blink leaves behind a Temporal Anomaly.

Allows you to wield a Two-Handed Axe, Mace, or Sword in each hand.

Also allows for a weapon or shield to be held in the off-hand while a Staff is equipped.

Physical damage dealt is reduced by 10%.

While a Staff is equipped in your main hand, your Magic damage and healing done are reduced by 0%.

   5 points: 210% combined weapon damage

You gain Tracking Mastery when learning any Tracking Ability. 

This Mastery automatically unlocks additional Tracking Abilities when you reach their Class Point requirements at no additional ability essence cost.

 Track Beasts

 Track Humanoids

 Track Undead

 Track Elementals

 Track Demons

 Track Giants

 Track Dragonkin

 Track Hidden

 Replenishment

 Corrupting Shadows

2 Charges, 60 sec recharge

    4 points: 40-43 damage
    5 points: 49-52 damage
